# MDL301 · `duplicate-key`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

The same key appears twice in a group.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | K13, G11 |

## Why

GLib keeps both lines but returns the last value for both: mydumper passes the option twice, with the last value each time. The first value is silently lost. It is an error when the values differ, a warning when the line is merely repeated. The fix deletes the earlier occurrences.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4
outputdir=/backup
threads=8

[mydumper]
outputdir=/backup
```

```text
2:1-2:8 error MDL301[duplicate-key] `threads` is set again on line 4 in [mydumper]: only the last value counts
  = The value `4` on this line is lost: `8` is used instead.
  note 4:1-4:8: the value that counts
  fix (unsafe): Delete this earlier occurrence
3:1-3:10 warning MDL301[duplicate-key] `outputdir` is set again on line 7 in [mydumper]: only the last value counts
  note 7:1-7:10: the value that counts
  fix (unsafe): Delete this earlier occurrence
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=8

[mydumper]
outputdir=/backup
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL301: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL301` on the line above it.
